subject: Civic Education
lesson: Presents information about other public services provided by the government: Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2
unique_learning_outcome: Presents information about other public services provided by the government.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher writes or reads “Presents information about other public services provided by the government” and asks students to name one example they have seen in everyday life. Students share brief responses; the teacher connects their examples to Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2 and explains how it will help them explore this period's outcome.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher introduces the lesson inquiry on 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government', organizes students into collaborative teams with designated roles, and distributes inquiry task prompt cards.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students arrange themselves in assigned group roles, examine the inquiry prompt concerning 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government', and prepare materials for their investigation.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Inquiry prompt cards, chalkboard, student notebooks

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher actively circulates among the groups to facilitate Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2, scaffolds student discussions around 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government', prompts critical thinking, and formatively monitors student engagement.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students actively carry out Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2, collaborating in teams to analyze real-world civic situations related to 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government' without passive bystanders.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Activity scenario cards, observation sheets, chart paper

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher facilitates group presentations, synthesizes student discoveries regarding 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government', highlights core civic values, and formatively clarifies any conceptual misconceptions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Team spokespersons present their group's findings on 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government' to the class, compare conclusions with peers, and record constructive feedback in their notebooks.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Presentation board, student summary sheets, whiteboard

summary: Synthesize key student findings from Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2, emphasizing the core principles of “Presents information about other public services provided by the government” and clarifying any lingering misconceptions.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Use the student's five-minute assignment response to check understanding of “Presents information about other public services provided by the government” and give one concise correction or affirmation.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Each student completes a short exit response explaining one finding about “Presents information about other public services provided by the government” using evidence or an example from Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2. The teacher reviews responses for an accurate link to the period outcome.
selected_activity:
Activity: Courtroom / Citizen Grievance Tribunal: Competency Level 8.1.2
Approach: Students use courtroom / citizen grievance tribunal to explore 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government.'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
